items.title: How AI Agents Turned One Exposed Endpoint into a Server Takeover
items.content: An investigation revealed the first confirmed incident where large language model-driven AI agents executed substantial portions of an attack. Within 24 hours, attackers exploited an exposed job-submission feature on an Apache Tomcat server running Spring Batch, requiring no authentication, zero-days, or new malware. The attacker used Cairn, an open-source AI agent orchestration platform,...

items.title: PEERSTITCH, a Stealthy FortiGate Implant
items.content: A sophisticated multi-stage network intrusion against a telecommunications organization in September 2024 exploited CVE-2024-47575 on a FortiManager appliance, exfiltrating configurations and cryptographic material for over 500 managed FortiGate firewalls. Attackers then exploited CVE-2025-61624 to deploy PEERSTITCH, a novel memory-resident ARM64 malware that leaves no disk artifacts or network... This pulse includes 15 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Telecommunications. Associated malware: PEERSTITCH.

items.title: Beyond the clipboard: The evolving tradecraft of ClickFix
items.content: Threat actors continue to evolve ClickFix tactics, moving beyond simple clipboard-based social engineering to more sophisticated attack chains. items.title: Ivanti CVE-2026-104935: Zero-Day Chain Exploited in Operation Innovate
items.content: Ivanti has released emergency security updates after attackers exploited a chain of three zero-day vulnerabilities in Connect Secure VPN appliances to gain root-level access without authentication.
